interpretation: structural citation validity and original-text hashes do not establish semantic support

bootstrap.method: query-level percentile bootstrap; 10,000 samples; seed 20261106; 95% interval
bootstrap.limits: within-dataset uncertainty; queries sharing evidence may be dependent; no external paired significance claim

flow_audit.usage_scope: sum of reported usage only; unknown attempts remain unknown

known_usage_price_reference_usd.scope: reported attempts only; reasoning is already in completion tokens; excludes unreported attempts, local hardware, tax and billing adjustments; not a bill or total cost bound

percentile_policy: analysis uses linearly interpolated NumPy quantiles; original runner order-statistic quantiles also retained

latency_definition.stream_total_ms: POST start through SSE end; includes retrieval and answer
latency_definition.user_total_ms: POST start through all evidence source and session rereads
latency_definition.first_answer_ms: first user-visible answer content; reasoning is not visible
latency_definition.service_total_ms: server completion latency, available only on completed streams

retrieval_stage_ablations.method: reconstruct original source rank and pre-reranking RRF from actual trace; require every source rank 1..20; no additional model answer runs
retrieval_stage_ablations.scope: retrieval-stage comparison on the same actual user queries; not full-answer A/B or independent system benchmarks

trec_eval.method: -c -q, linear-gain nDCG@10, Recall@20; reciprocal rank on top10; BEIR same-ID filtering
